regressions.what: A larger front-facing facet now falls into nearly black shadow where the target shows mottled grey stone down to the water.
Foam now has less contrast against the riverbed, especially along the front and right edges of the main boulder.

blockers.target: Near half frame height the lake spans roughly three quarters of the image, with the water meeting tall vegetation on both sides.
blockers.current: Water spans about half the image at that height, pinched by bare shelves extending inward from both sides.
blockers.change: Widen the lake at half frame height from roughly 20–70% to 12–87% of image width while retaining the new foreground outlet and boulder positions.

blockers.where: E3–F4 right shoulder and A2–B3 left bank
blockers.target: A continuous mass of tall grasses crowns the right gravel fan and the left bank rises into vegetation behind the cut face.
blockers.current: Open brown ground dominates the right shoulder, while the left grass ends abruptly in an isolated strip with exposed ground behind it.
blockers.change: Fill the landward side of the right gravel fan and the ground behind the left sod lip with overlapping grass and shrubs, burying the large exposed right-bank rocks to leave one low stone.

next.target: The lake carries broad olive vertical reflections, and blue-grey transparent shallows reveal rounded stones through narrow white wakes.
next.current: Small blue glints cover the entire lake, and the outlet appears brown with diffuse grey streaks.
next.change: Reduce lake normal strength and short-wave contrast, reflect the olive shore, expose a multiscale pebble bed through the outlet, and concentrate brighter foam along rock contacts.

next.target: Irregular roots overhang a visible brown soil face that slopes into loose stones.
next.current: A continuous pale rim borders a nearly black vertical wall with little visible surface relief.
next.change: Break the rim with exposed roots, lighten and roughen the cut earth, and build a sloping toe of soil and mixed stones down to the water.

next.target: Mixed rounded grey stones form a raised fan with shadows between pebbles and scattered stones under the grass.
next.current: Bright pale pebbles read as similarly sized spots on a thin tan strip.
